caption: Truong v. Delta International Machinery Corp.
citation_line: Truong v. Delta International Machinery Corp., No. 1:19-cv-19384, ECF No. 51 (D.N.J. Oct. 29, 2021)
headnote_district_ruling: Recommended denying a Rule 702 motion to exclude a machine-safety expert in a table-saw products-liability case. The expert's experience, an existing alternative guard, and the relative simplicity of the engineering question were sufficient; several criticisms went to weight.
qualification_rationale: A substantial application of Daubert and Third Circuit reliability doctrine to experience-based technical expertise, including when testing or physical inspection is unnecessary at the admissibility threshold.
appellate_posture_note: R&R; no published substantive appellate treatment identified.
